name: Ada Example
summary: Marketer who writes clearly about technical products and ties content to sign-ups. Comfortable owning strategy, writing, editing and reporting.

bullets.text: Grew organic traffic from 5,000 to 20,000 weekly visits by rebuilding the blog around search intent.
Restructured key pages so they are cited in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).
Managed four freelance writers against briefs and an editorial checklist.
Wrote launch copy, emails and sales enablement for two product releases.
Ran LinkedIn for six B2B clients and grew combined followers by 40%.
Built reporting dashboards in GA4 and Looker Studio for monthly client reviews.
